title: New Hampshire Farm Museum

services.name: Group Programs
services.desc: Our youth programs have always been a hit, but then we wondered, “Why are kids having all the fun??” The New Hampshire Farm Museum is excited to announce that we are expanding our hands-on, farm-based experiences to the entire community! We now offer programs for adults to immerse themselves in the beauty of farm life while exploring New Hampshire’s history and agricultural heritage. Our Community Programs are tailored to adults and are perfect for historical societies, book clubs, community centers, nursing homes, assisted living facilities, senior and retirement communities. CREATED FOR - This program is for adults - DATES - Offered May through October PROGRAM SIZE - 15-20 - COST - $15
